caption: The video showcases six teardrop-shaped foam pieces arranged in a two-by-three grid on a white surface. The top row contains red, green, and purple pieces, while the bottom row holds magenta, blue, and brown pieces. Each shape is already divided into two mirror-image halves separated by a narrow vertical gap. A black knife blade is the primary moving element interacting with these objects. Initially, the blade stands nearly vertically along the central cut line of the brown piece in the bottom right. The pointed tip rests near the top edge of the brown foam with minimal movement. The brown halves maintain their existing separation without visibly widening during this phase. Midway through, the blade withdraws to the right and exits the brown piece, leaving it resting with its narrow gap intact, like the other pieces. Shortly after, the blade re-enters from the top left corner and positions itself diagonally over the red piece. The tip contacts the left half of the red foam near its central gap, remaining with slight positional adjustments until the clip ends.
relations: The black knife blade positioned on the brown foam piece maintains the narrow gap between its halves.
When the blade withdraws to the right, the brown piece remains resting with its central split intact.
As the blade re-enters from the top left, it positions diagonally over the red foam piece.
The blade tip contacts the left half of the red piece near its central gap.
